fundamentals.long_business_summary: Praetorian Acquisition Corp. does not have significant operations. It focuses on effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company intends to focus on businesses in traditional sectors that can be transformed through the application of automation and artificial intelligence. The company was incorporated in 2025 and is based in Miami, Florida.
